title: The Business of Community week cards fit a phone

source.ref: e2e-manual run 44380142715 (2026-11-18, production): /courses/business-of-community overflowed at 320, 360 and 390 px; each week card ran 19 to 98 px past a 320 px viewport (overflow.spec.ts).

detail: The stacked week list and cards used a 1fr column, whose min-content floor let the meeting chip (white-space:nowrap, e.g. 'The full gathering · 90 min, plus 10 the next day') push each card past the phone edge. The week list, a stacked card and the stacked fixes/leave-with grid now use minmax(0,1fr). Under 560 px, the card body padding drops to 26/22 px and the chip in a week's title row may wrap. Checked in Chrome on production with the new rules injected into a 320/360/390 px frame: no week element past the edge (before: 42/28/7 boxes past the edge); the only remaining box is the decorative .fq-aura that every hero carries.

verify.note: Fails on main: the stacked week grids use 1fr and the chip never wraps. Passes once they use minmax(0,1fr) and the chip in the week title row wraps on a phone.
